reasoning: A classic five-pointed outlined star, universally recognized at any size. It fits tasks centered on leaving ratings/reviews, curating favorites/bookmarks, stargazing/astronomy, or literal star decorations, though users must avoid applying it merely as a priority marker when a task has a concrete subject.
